worldcombat.skill.discharge.summary: Lets electricity burst out of the body: foes in the ring around the user (airborne or grounded) are all zapped once, every real hit trails an arc from the user to that target, and a hit target may be paralysed. Every form fires once; Overcharge narrows and strengthens it, hitting at most 3 targets.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.use.0: Zap a whole ring when surrounded
worldcombat.skill.discharge.use.1: An indiscriminate sweep that also hits airborne foes
worldcombat.skill.discharge.use.2: Paralyse the foes pressed against you
Arcs burst from the body: at most %2$s foes in the sphere around the user each take about %1$s damage once; airborne and grounded targets are both hit. The target's Sp. Def, type and crit are settled on the hit.
The electric ring covers %1$s blocks around the user (a sphere around the body centre); a foe whose line of sight is blocked by solid blocks is not chained.

A hit target has a %1$s chance to be paralysed, rolled once per target: while paralysed it moves about 50%% slower and each attempt to act has a 25%% chance to fail; the effect wears off after 40 s and can also be cured.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.overcharge.o: Overcharge on: the ring shrinks to ×0.72, main damage about 28%% stronger and paralysis about 35%% more likely, hitting at most 3 targets: wind-up +2 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
Overcharge off (wide): a wider ring hitting up to 8 targets, folding half of the old second echo into this one strike, for lighting up a group at once.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.timing: Cast on the space within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.growth.0: At level %1$s the discharge rises to %2$s power, the ring to %3$s blocks, and the paralysis chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.preference.o: On: a narrower ring that hits harder with a higher paralysis chance and at most 3 targets, with a longer wind-up and cooldown, for punching through one tough target. Off: a wider ring hitting up to 8 targets.
worldcombat.skill.discharge.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion walks in instead of discharging; higher opens earlier but lets foes step away first.
With this on, the companion raises Discharge when 2 or more foes stand within its own reach, so one burst catches the ring; off keeps the normal attack order.
